Name: Ilucie's Pepper Rex (for 1.6)
Author: IlucieYt
Description:
Adorable, fat Pepper Rex in three different colors for your barn!

They lay eggs, than can be sold or processed into Pepper Egg Mayonnaise.

__________________________________________________________________________

This mod is compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22021] dwarven expansion[/url] - just install the optional file as well!

Downloads.Description:
Changed the structure of the mod and added new features:
→ Pepper Rexes in different colors can now be purchased directly - they’re no longer random
→ Pepper Rexes can be sold

Updating the mod is safe and won’t affect existing Pepper Rexes
